newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares seen stable in higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares seen stable in higher turnover.

text.p: Hungarian share prices are expected to stabilise on Tuesday after domestic investors on Monday pushed the BUX index two percent higher to a new record level of 5,991.32 points, traders said.

"We can expect a steady market with slight movements in either direction," said Peter Tolgyesi of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz. "We can also expect an increase in turnover with the return of foreign investors who were away from the market on Monday."
Although Hungarian investors play an increasing role in the Budapest Stock Exchange's share trading, foreign investors, particularly from the UK and the U.S. still generate the bulk of the turnover.
In the lack of foreign orders on Monday, eager domestic investors appeared to pay any price and drove the BUX index to a new record on the first day of the week.
Balazs Szabo of Eastbrokers said the market might receive support from the dollar which has gained some 50 fillers against the forint since Monday's close of 181.05/15.
